blue_weight.description: Route53 weighted routing weight for the blue environment (0-255).

domain_name.description: Root domain for the public Route53 hosted zone that serves the weighted records (e.g. "example.com").

green_weight.description: Route53 weighted routing weight for the green environment (0-255). Raise gradually (e.g. 10 -> 50 -> 100) while lowering blue_weight to shift traffic blue -> green.

instance_type.description: EC2 instance type for the Beanstalk auto scaling instances.

record_subdomain.description: Single DNS label for the weighted CNAME records. Records live at "<record_subdomain>.<domain_name>" (e.g. "app" -> "app.example.com").

solution_stack_name.description: Elastic Beanstalk solution stack used by both environments.
